run_cli_load_dataset: run the cli to load a dataset from Hugging Face Hub with a given name and revision
run_cli_load_from_cache: run the cli to load a dataset from local cache with download flag enabled
run_cli_query_dataset: run the cli query command to scan dataset records with a specified offset and limit
run_cli_index_dataset: run the cli index command to download and index parquet files for a dataset
run_dataset_sync_scan: run dataset sync_scan to retrieve record batches and identify files missing offset indexes
